name: Moldavite
source:
Meteorite falls from the sky. Its study boosts technology triggering multiple years of war.
Many years have passed since the fall. Main character is a boy with a dream to become the best summoner in the world. One day he overhears a story of powerful legendary cards. He travels to the foreign land to gather all these cards.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一颗陨石从天而降。对它的研究大幅推动技术发展，也引发了持续多年的战争。
陨石坠落已经过去许多年。主人公是一名少年，梦想成为世界最强的召唤师。一天，他偶然听说了几张力量强大的传说卡片，于是前往异国他乡，准备把所有卡片收集齐全。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
